coverage.evidence: LookupTemplateHelpers.cs:38-43 registers every LookupRow, and the row min and max argument counts match the page. lookup.twitch takes 1 argument (LookupTwitchHelpers.cs:28-33) with the fields at :43-66 and followage: at :38,81-82. lookup.game takes 1 argument with boxart and lookup.game.top takes 0 (LookupGameHelpers.cs:23-37,42). lookup.weather takes 1 argument with the fields at LookupWeatherHelpers.cs:24-29,37-46. lookup.time takes 1 argument with date and offset (LookupTimeHelpers.cs:26-31,36). lookup.currency takes 3, lookup.currency.rate takes 2 and lookup.currency.date takes 0 to 2 (LookupCurrencyHelpers.cs:26-50). lookup.translate takes 2 or 3 and lookup.translate.chat takes 1 (LookupTranslateHelpers.cs:26-40,53-56). That makes the ten helpers the description names.

Twitch results: createdAt is yyyy-MM-dd, viewers is N0 in the channel culture and url is built locally (LookupTwitchHelpers.cs:53-66). Uptime is 'Xh Ym' and under an hour 'Xm Ys' (StreamText.cs:68-75), and follow age reads like '1 year, 3 months' (StreamText.cs:44-65). Box art is 285x380 (LookupGameHelpers.cs:51). Weather prints 'Place: temp, condition' (LookupWeatherHelpers.cs:61-63) in whole degrees, C and F, with an en dash range (WeatherText.cs:75-84) and Dutch or English words (WeatherText.cs:56-72). Time is HH:mm, the date is 'dddd d MMMM' in the channel culture, and the offset text comes from LookupTimeHelpers.cs:58-80. Currency: the converted amount has two decimals in the channel culture, the rate has up to four, the date is yyyy-MM-dd and the default pair is EUR to USD (LookupCurrencyHelpers.cs:76-102). Cache lifetimes: Twitch 60s (LookupData.cs:34), forecast 10 minutes (OpenMeteoWeatherClient.cs:31), Frankfurter 6 hours (FrankfurterCurrencyClient.cs:24), MyMemory 1 day (MyMemoryTranslationClient.cs:29). The follower count and the follow check are not cached (LookupData.cs:132-154).

Each lookup row defaults to TemplateHelperContexts.Standard (LookupRow.cs:56-57). That is every context except Viewer (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22): Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord and Webhook (TemplateHelperContext.cs:18-62; the same list is in TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-39). lookup.translate.chat uses WithTriggerViewerAndDiscord, which leaves out Timer (LookupTranslateHelpers.cs:44; TemplateHelperContexts.cs:32-45). A timer save validates against the Timer context (TimerManagementService.cs:50-57).

OpenMeteoAllowed is false in saas mode (LookupSources.cs:50), and its comment gives the noncommercial-only reason and the restriction marker (LookupSources.cs:19-24). Weather and time then return their fallback (LookupWeatherHelpers.cs:55-56; LookupTimeHelpers.cs:44-45). translate.chat is excluded from timers (LookupTranslateHelpers.cs:44). Viewer text gets only Viewer-context helpers, and any other token returns null and prints as written (TemplateResolver.cs:123-127,154-155). Lookup rows never list Viewer (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22). The dashboard mentions saas only in admin views (AdminBillingView.vue:27, AdminSupportView.vue:142, ChannelSummaryPanel.vue:124).

A wrong argument count returns null, so the braces print (LookupRow.cs:59-62). For Twitch, a bad login pattern, a missing or unknown field, or followers or followage for another channel also return null (LookupTwitchHelpers.cs:76-86,118-119,128-129). A Twitch user, channel or stream that fails gives the Twitch fallback (LookupTwitchHelpers.cs:94-114,131-135). isLive is false, and viewers and uptime are empty, when there is no stream (LookupTwitchHelpers.cs:55-62). A non-follower gets an empty follow age (LookupTwitchHelpers.cs:137-139). Weather and time keep an unknown field in the city name, because Split matches only the known fields (LookupRow.cs:91-98). The unavailable notes in English and Dutch are at LookupFallbacks.cs:30-37,44-45. Timeouts are 2s for Twitch (LookupData.cs:33,217-218) and the outside services, and 3s for translation (MyMemoryTranslationClient.cs:30).

Text over 500 UTF-8 bytes returns null before any fetch, which gives the fallback (MyMemoryTranslationClient.cs:27,38-39; LookupTranslateHelpers.cs:85-86). The text is sent to api.mymemory.translated.net (MyMemoryTranslationClient.cs:54-59). With 2 arguments the source language is English, and with 3 the first argument is the source (LookupTranslateHelpers.cs:53-56). For chat, the source is the channel language and the text is the args seed, then message (LookupTranslateHelpers.cs:48,58-65; ChatMessageHandler.cs:1918). Language codes must match ^[A-Za-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z]{2,4})?$ (LookupTranslateHelpers.cs:50). When both languages are the same, the text is returned and nothing is sent (LookupTranslateHelpers.cs:82-83).

reader_answers.evidence: Weather takes one city argument with an optional field such as temp (LookupWeatherHelpers.cs:28-29,37,51). Currency takes amount|from|to (LookupCurrencyHelpers.cs:30-31,62-69). currency.rate takes the two currencies (LookupCurrencyHelpers.cs:39-40,83).

Weather and time do not work in saas mode (LookupSources.cs:50; LookupWeatherHelpers.cs:55-56; LookupTimeHelpers.cs:44-45). Saas is a deployment mode of the whole bot (DeploymentContext Mode, LookupSources.cs:50), and the channel dashboard does not show it; it appears only in admin views.

The default weather output is 'Place: temp, condition' (LookupWeatherHelpers.cs:61-62). An invalid expression returns null, so the braces print (LookupRow.cs:59-62). A service failure gives the bracketed note (LookupFallbacks.cs:30-37). A valid empty result is an empty string (LookupTwitchHelpers.cs:57,62,139).

args and args.N are seeded from the command text (ChatMessageHandler.cs:1909-1928). The amount is parsed with the invariant culture and must be from 0 to 1e12 (LookupCurrencyHelpers.cs:54,62-68). Codes are three letters (LookupCurrencyHelpers.cs:56-57,106-113). An invalid argument returns null, so the braces print (LookupCurrencyHelpers.cs:70).
